headword: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}

definitions.gloss: change of seasons; seasonal transition; turning point between seasons
definitions.explanation: The transitional period when one season shifts to the next. In Japan, these transitions are culturally significant and are closely associated with changes in health, wardrobe, and diet.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}は{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすい。
examples.english: It's easy to get sick at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}には{衣替|ころもが}えをする。
examples.english: People switch out their wardrobes at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}は{気温|きおん}の{変動|へんどう}が{大|おお}きいので、{風邪|かぜ}を{引|ひ}かないように{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Temperature fluctuations are large during the change of seasons, so please be careful not to catch a cold.

notes:
Composed of {季節|きせつ} (season) + の + {変|か}わり{目|め} (turning point, transition). A very common expression in daily life, especially in health-related conversations. Japanese culture places great importance on seasonal transitions, and this phrase appears frequently in weather forecasts, health advice, and everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す: to fall ill at the change of seasons
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}の{挨拶|あいさつ}: seasonal transition greetings
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}は{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}: caution is needed at seasonal transitions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {季節|きせつ}の{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり: seasonal change — similar meaning, slightly more literary
- {端境期|はざかいき}: between-seasons period — originally an agricultural term for the gap between harvests
